actionable_steps.citation: Install padukas in your heart — SSS Vol 32 (1999), 1999-10-01
actionable_steps.step: Develop humility in order to get rid of ego — no spiritual practice can help a man of ego attain tranquility and bliss.

actionable_steps.citation: The most profitable job — SSS Vol 10 (1970), 1970-05-13
actionable_steps.step: Serve the world as you would serve your master — be humble, be eager, be efficient in that service.

actionable_steps.citation: Practise And Propagate Our Sacred Culture — SSS Vol 36 (2003), 2003-04-15
actionable_steps.step: Respect everyone — offer your namaskara with humility and reverence, without a trace of ego and attachment.

actionable_steps.citation: Spiritual basis for value education — SSS Vol 20 (1987), 1987-09-24
actionable_steps.step: Bend the body. Mend the senses. End the mind. Cultivate humility as the first step.

actionable_steps.citation: The Lord and the devotee — SSS Vol 29 (1996), 1996-08-22
actionable_steps.step: Do not become egoistic just because you are educated — do not be proud of your intelligence.

actionable_steps.citation: Noble mothers breed noble sons — SSS Vol 28 (1995), 1995-02-15
actionable_steps.step: Examine your faults, if any, and try to correct them — as Eeshvar Chandhra Vidhyasagar did daily.

definition.citation: The educational crisis and the way out — SSS Vol 30 (1997), 1997-11-22
definition.quote: Humility is the hall-mark of true education. Humility does not mean moving about with a bowed head. It calls for respect to humanness.

discourses.citation: The Lord and the devotee — SSS Vol 29 (1996), 1996-08-22
discourses.quote: Students! Education bestows humility (vidya dadati vinayam). Humility is the hallmark of education and its very goal. Humility does not mean merely to bow your head and stand with folded arms. Humility means to perform actions without ego.

discourses.citation: Give Up Ego And Attachment To Become Great — SSS Vol 40 (2007), 2007-02-17
discourses.quote: It is only humility and obedience that brought great honour to Vidyasagar... Greatness is not in the education we pursue or the high academic degrees we obtain. It is humility and obedience that bring greatness to us.

discourses.citation: From Knowledge To Wisdom — SSS Vol 25 (1992), 1992-05-22
discourses.quote: For every man, humility and reverence are valuable ornaments. Humility is the hallmark of right education.

discourses.citation: Seeing Only Brahman In All — SSS Vol 3 (1963), 1963-12-15
discourses.quote: Be humble, be calm, be tolerant. Cooperate with all and treat everyone with courtesy and kindness.

make_it_real: Humility isn't thinking less of yourself — it's thinking of others first. Bow the head, empty the ego, and let love take the lead.
title: Humility

vahinis.quote: Spiritual learning (vidya) involves humility, tolerance, and discipline. It destroys arrogance, envy, and all related vices. Such knowledge is the real Atmic knowledge.
Valid education (vidya) helps one achieve success in this process of mastery. Education promotes humility (vidya confers vinaya). Through humility, one acquires the right to engage in professions.
